_provenance: Produced by V11 batch 1 (T11-03). Describes the interface the trainer now accepts; no training run was launched with it. Paid compute and production changes are not authorized.

interpreter.note: The default `python` on this machine (Anaconda 3.13.5) has no torch. A torch-enabled interpreter was `py -3.12` (torch 2.14.0+cpu). Use V11_PYTHON / PYTHON to point the trainer at one.

plannedManifest.warning: Pre-training plan (index split). It does NOT prove which samples were optimized.

optimizedManifest.writtenWhen: after training, accumulated only on successful optimizer.step()

updateLedger.content: one line per optimizer step: epoch, update index, batchSize, sampleIds, mask counts
updateLedger.property: every aggregate in the optimized manifest can be recomputed from this ledger

legacyFlag.status: retained for compatibility but now labelled `measured: false` with an explicit warning
legacyFlag.reason: In V10 this file was written before training and then used to certify DAgger coverage - a closed loop that could not fail.

globalLimit.note: checked against the measured update count, so it holds across epochs

policyLossMask.effect: False multiplies that row's policy loss by zero; the row is still counted as an exposure

valueLossMask.effect: a row with a null value target never contributes value gradient

supervisionMasks.rule: A real value label never implies the played action was good. A truncated episode teaches policy but not value.

failLoudlyGuards: unknown rootFamilyId in the split manifest -> ValueError (previously defaulted into train)
duplicate sampleId mapping to two different stateHash values -> ValueError
empty validation partition -> ValueError (previously carved from the tail of train)
notDone: optimizer state save/restore is NOT implemented; the V11 taskbook asks for it or for an explicit re-initialisation. Controls currently all start from a fresh optimizer.
architecture-extension zero-initialisation (GAP from zero, residual last layer zero) is NOT implemented - F06 remains partially open.
DAgger training whitelist update and ancestor-overlap check are NOT implemented.

verification.lastRun: py -3.12 -m unittest discover -s python/tests -> 14 tests OK
